_README: Recommended Deadlock controls (research 2026-10-25, docs/controls.md). binds = action name in the game's citadelkeys_personal.lst -> primary key, or a list = the exact set of keys over both slots (Key, Key2); set in Settings > Keybinds (the file is a Steam cloud file this repo never edits); tools/vw_controls.py check reads them back. convars_checked = the controls cvars config/autoexec.cfg sets (sensitivity). reticle = menu-set targets read back from the hero-settings cloud file. menu = settings with no verified cvar value, set by hand.
mouse: Rapique R110, DPI steps 800/1200/1600 (button), set to step 2 of 3 = 1200 (operator 2026-10-25); tools/vw_dpi.py measure

reticle._README: Targets in remote/cfg/citadel_hero_settings.lst base (the game's own reticle store; it overrides the citadel_crosshair_* cvars). Set in Settings > Game > Reticle; vw_controls.py check reads it back.

menu.Keybinds > Abilities > Casting mode: Quick Cast (disputed; per-ability fallback in Advanced > Hero-Specific Settings)
